housing_building_stock_character: Not described as a distinct residential housing-stock profile in the article; character is framed as a regional transport hub and manufacturing centre undergoing long-term urban renewal. Historic building stock includes 19th-century stucco-rendered brick civic buildings (e.g. Dandenong Town Hall).
source_quotes: Dandenong ... is a southeastern suburb of Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, about 29 km (18 mi) from the Melbourne CBD. It is the council seat of the City of Greater Dandenong local government area, with a recorded population of 30,127 at the 2021 census.
A regional transport hub and manufacturing centre of Victoria, Dandenong is located at the junctional region of the Dandenong Valley Highway, Princes Highway, Monash Freeway and Dingley Freeway
Dandenong's redevelopment is undertaken by Development Victoria ... The project is a long-term project, expected to continue for 15 to 20 years.
The two-storey, stucco rendered brick building, on a bluestone base course, features a lofty, Mansard-roofed, corner clock tower
